results.title: Nature and outdoors can help boost your health - here's how
results.snippet: Spending just 20 minutes in nature can lower blood pressure, heart rate and stress levels.

results.title: World Mental Health Day: Nature's Benefits
results.snippet: Being outdoors can trigger measurable changes inside your body from lowering stress hormones, easing blood pressure and even improving your gut ...

results.title: You don't have to be outside all day to reap nature's benefits
results.snippet: Studies show that regularly spending time outdoors confers a host of mental health benefits. These include relief of anxiety and stress.
